openQaFindings.note: PRODUCT_DECISION_REQUIRED Donor/Donee — kept as English loanwords; 'donee' is not a Dutch word and may confuse users. Declension handled as invariable plural 'donors'/'donees' and 'de donee' (onboarding, profile, typeYourMessageForDonee). Alternatives: Gever / Ontvanger / Aanvrager.

Homonymy: 'bericht' = Post (Bericht plaatsen, Berichten laden) but also used for chat/review messages (typeYourMessageForDonee 'Typ je bericht voor een donee...', profileUi.reviewPlaceholder, inspirationNeedTextOrImage 'kort bericht'). Consider 'boodschap'/'tekst' for non-post uses.

Donation metaphor mixed: edit.donations='Steun', tokensToTopUp='TOKENS OM TE STEUNEN', topUpThePost='STEUN HET BERICHT', byTop='via steun', notifications 'gesteund', but glossary lists 'Opladen / Steun'. Consistent in practice (Steun), glossary row should be finalised by human.

'Melding' is used both for notifications (Meldingen) and for abuse reports (Melding verzenden, Melding succesvol verzonden, reportIssue). Context-dependent ambiguity; consider 'Rapportage'/'Rapport' or 'Klacht' for reports.
settings.privacy.terms 'Algemene voorwaarden' vs termsOfUseLink / legal 'Gebruiksvoorwaarden' — terminology consistency (EN source differs: 'Terms and Conditions').
onboarding.tokens.page2Option ('Wij brengen dromers samen met mensen die') is an incomplete sentence mirroring placeholder-like EN copy; page3Title 'Geldstroom' similarly terse.

Register: 'Time-out van het verzoek' (errors.timeout) is a literal calque; consider 'Het verzoek duurde te lang'. 'Vuist vol/Zak vol/Kist vol' token package names are playful calques; 'Vuist vol' could be 'Vuistvol' — humans to confirm tone.
Gender-neutral possessives: 'zijn of haar' (legacySideBlurb, tokens.page1Text) vs 'hun' (userBlocked, 'Hun berichten') and 'zijn droom' (explainerTitle4) — inconsistent gender-inclusive style.
